description: Header defining a templated class 'bounded_bitset' for managing a fixed-capacity, dynamically-sized bitset with various utility methods, including bit manipulation, conversion, slicing, and formatting. It supports different bit orderings and includes functions for bitwise operations, iteration over set bits, and advanced folding and slicing operations.

classes.name: bounded_bitset
classes.description: A template class representing a fixed-capacity, dynamically-sized bitset with support for various bit manipulations, conversions, slicing, and formatting, configurable for bit order and size.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the bitset, sanitizing bits if shrinking.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a specific bit to true or false.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all bits to false.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Sets all bits to true or false.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Appends a bit or multiple bits to the bitset.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts a range of bits as an unsigned integer.

methods.name: to_uint64
methods.description: Converts the bitset to a 64-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: from_uint64
methods.description: Loads a 64-bit unsigned integer into the bitset.

methods.name: to_packed_bits
methods.description: Converts the bitset into an array of packed bits.

methods.name: to_unpacked_bits
methods.description: Converts the bitset into an array of individual booleans.

methods.name: get_bit_positions
methods.description: Returns positions of bits set to 1 or 0.

methods.name: find_lowest
methods.description: Finds the lowest set or unset bit.

methods.name: find_highest
methods.description: Finds the highest set or unset bit.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Checks if any bit is set.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Checks if all bits are set.

methods.name: none
methods.description: Checks if no bits are set.

methods.name: is_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if bits with a specific value are contiguous.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts bits set to 1.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of two bitsets.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality of two bitsets.

methods.name: operator|=
methods.description: Bitwise OR assignment.

methods.name: operator&=
methods.description: Bitwise AND assignment.

methods.name: operator~
methods.description: Bitwise NOT.

methods.name: to_string_of_bits
methods.description: Formats bitset as string of bits.

methods.name: to_string_of_hex
methods.description: Formats bitset as hexadecimal string.
